record.paper_title: Conjectures and Open Questions on the Structure and Regularity of Spaces with Lower Ricci Curvature Bounds
record.original_question: Let (M^n, g, x) be a Riemannian manifold with Ric ≥ −λ and Vol(B_1(x)) > v > 0. Does there exist a constant C(n, λ, v) such that the scalar curvature has a uniform local L^1 bound ∫_(B_1(x)) R < C?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 2.18 (noncollapsing Yau’s conjecture). Let Mn, g, x satisfy Ric ≥ −λ and Vol(B1(p)) > v > 0, then ∃ C(n, λ, v) > 0 such that ∫B1(x) R < C.

artifact.category_tag: Ricci curvature and scalar curvature bounds
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n \geq 2$ be an integer and let $\lambda > 0$ and $v > 0$ be real constants. Consider any pointed complete $n$-dimensional Riemannian manifold $(M^n, g, x)$ satisfying the lower Ricci curvature bound $\mathrm{Ric}_g \geq -\lambda\, g$ and the noncollapsing volume bound $\mathrm{Vol}(B_1(x)) > v$, where $B_1(x)$ denotes the open geodesic ball of radius $1$ about $x$. Let $R_g$ denote the scalar curvature of $g$.

Prove or disprove: there exists a constant $C = C(n, \lambda, v) > 0$, depending only on $n$, $\lambda$, and $v$, such that
$$\int_{B_1(x)} R_g \, d\mathrm{vol}_g < C$$
for every such $(M^n, g, x)$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is a noncollapsing version of Yau's conjecture on local L^1 bounds for scalar curvature under a lower Ricci bound. It is widely cited as an open conjecture in recent surveys and research on Ricci limit spaces; web searches in 2024–2025 turn up related results (e.g., L^2 curvature bounds under two-sided Ricci bounds, integral Ricci bounds for collapsed spaces) but no proof or disproof of this specific noncollapsed L^1 scalar curvature conjecture. It appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Integral Ricci curvature bounds for possibly collapsed spaces with Ricci curvature bounded from below
status_evidence.snippet: Integral bounds for Ricci curvature under lower Ricci bound assumptions, related but distinct from the scalar L^1 problem.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work addresses related integral curvature bounds but does not resolve the noncollapsed L^1 scalar curvature conjecture.

status_evidence.title: L^2 Curvature Bounds on Manifolds with Bounded Ricci Curvature
status_evidence.snippet: Cheeger–Naber establish L^2 bounds on the full Riemann curvature assuming two-sided Ricci bounds and noncollapsing.
status_evidence.claim: Stronger curvature integral bounds are known under two-sided Ricci bounds, but the one-sided lower bound case for scalar curvature L^1 remains the open Yau-type conjecture.
